description: This source file contains a command-line application written in Go that initializes an agent client, performs a discovery operation based on environment variables, and outputs the results in various formats. It includes functions for building discovery options from environment variables, parsing boolean environment variables, and splitting CSV strings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that initializes the agent client, performs discovery with options derived from environment variables, and outputs the result.

methods.name: buildDiscoveryOptionsFromEnv
methods.description: Constructs a slice of discovery options based on environment variables for use in the discovery process.

methods.name: parseEnvBool
methods.description: Parses an environment variable to a boolean value, returning true if the variable represents a truthy value.

methods.name: parseEnvBoolStrict
methods.description: Strictly parses an environment variable and returns its boolean value along with a bool indicating successful parsing.

methods.name: splitCSV
methods.description: Splits a comma-separated string into a slice of trimmed strings.
